description: This file defines the PersonService interface in the OpenMRS API, containing method signatures for managing Person-related entities such as persons, relationships, attributes, and merge logs. It includes operations for creating, retrieving, updating, voiding/unvoiding, and deleting persons, relationships, and related data structures, along with handling relationship types, person attribute types, and merge logs.

classes.name: PersonService
classes.description: Interface for person-related operations in the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations for persons, relationships, attributes, and logs, with security annotations for privilege control.

methods.name: setPersonDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO object used by this service.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Retrieves persons matching a search phrase and status flags.
